description: Spring Boot REST controller handling CRUD operations for Answer entities related to questions in a PostgreSQL database using JPA repositories.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: Spring REST controller managing endpoints related to Answer entities, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting answers associated with questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of answers for a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new answer to a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer associated with a question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer associated with a question.
